Use WebFetch on:
1. https://www.fiercebiotech.com/special-reports/2025-biotech-graveyard
2. https://www.biospace.com/business/biopharma-bankruptcies-still-at-peak-with-little-relief-in-sight

Also run WebSearch queries: "biotech bankruptcy Chapter 11 2025 delisted Nasdaq ticker", "biotech delisted Nasdaq 2026 ticker drug developer", "clinical-stage biotech liquidation 2025 wind down delisted".

Known leads to confirm/date with ticker: NKGen Biotech (NKGN, delisted ~Mar 2025), Omega Therapeutics (Chapter 11 ~2025), Clearside Biomedical (Chapter 11 Nov 23 2025), IO Biotech, Lipella Pharmaceuticals, Lipocine. Find more.

For EACH report: ticker | company | event (bankruptcy / delisted to OTC / liquidated) | approximate date | one source URL. Only sourced items. Flag uncertain "unverified". Note if a company moved to OTC vs fully delisted. Exclude pure acquisitions (another agent covers those). Be concise — clean list, no preamble.
